elaine-sales: Hey team — CareLoop wants a 2-week POC. They need Private/VPC deployment + a small Dedicated GPU pool. Main asks: ephemeral demo API keys, Dedicated sizing for ~100 rps, audit log export to their Splunk + S3 for 12mo, KMS key wrapping, and answers for the security questionnaire. Can we scope rollout and blockers?

jordan-se: Thanks — quick clarifying q's: which region (us-west-2 or eu-west-1)? do they need full VPC peering or just outbound egress to our ingestion endpoints? Any data residency constraints?

elaine-sales: CareLoop is US-only for now (us-west-2). They want full private connectivity (peering) and no internet-facing endpoints for inference during the POC.

alex-platform: We can do a Private deployment in us-west-2 with dedicated pool. For ~100 rps baseline (short sequences) recommend 4x A10G-ish equivalents (pool autoscale off by default for POC) — gives headroom. For ephemeral keys we can generate time-limited tokens that auto-expire after the demo window.

alex-platform: High-level VPC notes (we'll fill infra ticket):
```bash
# customer VPC details we need:
CUSTOMER_VPC_CIDR=10.2.0.0/16
REDWOOD_PRIVATE_SUBNET=172.31.128.0/20
# we'll request peering + route table update; security groups allow only customer CIDRs
```

alex-platform: For audit logs we support streaming to Splunk HEC and S3. We can redact user-provided prompt text on export if needed. Sample Splunk config we usually ask for:
```json
{
  "hec_endpoint": "https://splunk.careloop.internal:8088/services/collector",
  "hec_token": "<provisioned-by-customer>",
  "format": "json_event",
  "fields": ["request_id","model","latency_ms","decision"],
  "retention_days": 365
}
```

marco-security: Re: KMS & PII — we support CMKs (bring-your-own) for key wrapping. For the POC we need their KMS ARN + proof of key policy that allows Redwood principal. Also confirm classification: will prompts contain PHI? If yes, we recommend additional safeguards and redaction pipeline.

marco-security: Security questionnaire: I can start populating sections 1–4 (Infra, Access, Data flows). Can @elaine-sales drop the latest questionnaire PDF here? We usually need ~48 hours to produce the full pack (evidence snippets + config).

elaine-sales: Dropping questionnaire and their Splunk endpoint details in a DM to marco-security.

sam-legal: Heads-up: CareLoop will require a short DPA + SOW for the dedicated pool trial. I can draft a limited-term DPA (14d) and trial SOW. Need point of contact and billing entity.

elaine-sales: POC contact: katie@careloop.ai; billing entity: CareLoop Inc.

jordan-se: Pricing for the 2-week POC (ballpark):
- Dedicated pool baseline (4 units equivalent): ~$3,500/week (list -> we give dev trial discount)
- Private deployment setup (VPC peering, KMS integration, Splunk hook): one-time ~ $1,200 engineering/setup fee
- If they want autoscale on during POC hourly burn could increase; we'll keep it fixed for predictability.

elaine-sales: Can we issue ephemeral hosted API keys for the demo UI while private endpoints are being provisioned? They want to demo to internal PMs before network cutover.

alex-platform: Yes — we can issue ephemeral hosted keys scoped to demo routes + token caps (e.g., 10k tokens/day) and auto-revoke at TTL. Those keys are logged and auditable.

sre-bot: Provisioning ticket created: INFRA-4821 — Private POC (CareLoop) us-west-2, 4-unit pool, Splunk HEC streaming, S3 archive 365d, KMS BYOK. ETA: 3 business days.

marco-security: Also adding: require access logs for admin actions, key rotation evidence, and sample audit CSVs (format we provide) for SOC review. We can redact content fields for POC export.

elaine-sales: Perfect. Next steps: jordan — can you confirm price/discount and include in POC quote? alex — please confirm ETA on network setup. marco — start questionnaire answers; sam — DPA draft. I'll update CareLoop with expected timelines.

jordan-se: Will send a formal quote today with dev trial discount and note the one-time setup fee.

alex-platform: ETA for network and pool provisioning: ~72 hours after ticket approval and signed SOW. I’ll add the step-by-step rollout plan into INFRA-4821.

sam-legal: I'll circulate the DPA + short SOW by EOD.

elaine-sales: Thanks all :rocket: — looping @katie-careloop on next message to set expectations.

sre-bot: INFRA-4821 status updated: in-progress (assigned to @alex-platform).
